summary.goal: Display and handle change requests from orchestrator during execution
summary.context: Orchestrator can request plan changes mid-execution (missing steps, wrong dependencies). These surface as action items in the UI, creating a new draft version for review.

acceptance_criteria.description: Change requests appear as action items (prominent notification)
Change request shows: reason, suggested changes, source run
User can view diff between original and suggested changes
Accept creates new draft version with changes applied
New draft version links back to change request for traceability

steps.title: Create change request notification
steps.description: Prominent notification when change requests exist for a plan.

acceptance_criteria.description: Banner at top of plan view

steps.title: Create ChangeRequestCard component
steps.description: Card showing change request details with reason and suggested changes.

steps.title: Create change diff view
steps.description: Side-by-side or inline diff showing original vs suggested changes.

steps.title: Implement accept change request
steps.description: Accept button creates new draft version with suggested changes applied.

acceptance_criteria.description: Accept calls API to create new version

steps.title: Implement reject change request
steps.description: Reject button dismisses the change request with optional reason.

steps.title: Show change request link on version
steps.description: Versions created from change requests show link back to request.
